Is there an official Ladner Rural boundary?
Ladner Rural is an MLS® sub-area name used by the real estate board rather than an official municipal boundary, so ask me to verify any specific address.
How big can the house and yard area be on a farm?
Delta’s farm home plate can be up to 3,600 square metres with one farm house, or 5,000 square metres with an Additional Farm House. Confirm current rules with Delta.
Can I get farm class on my property?
BC Assessment sets minimum gross farm income by size. For an operation over 4 ha it is $2,500 plus 5% of the actual value of the area over 4 ha.
Do I need ALC approval to add fill?
For accessory farm dwellings and non-farm-use structures, fill may need an ALC Notice of Intent. For farm houses and farm buildings, one is needed above 1,000 square metres.
